clues.it: Tea era nella 7ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Nino e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Tea was in the 7th column, in a different room from Nino and in the Galley.

clues.it: Nino era nella 4ª colonna e da solo in Plancia.
clues.en: Nino was in the 4th column and alone on the Bridge.

clues.it: Luca era a nord di Sergio e in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Luca was north of Sergio and in the Galley, but was not beside a shelf.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 5ª riga e accanto a una sedia, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 5th row and beside a chair, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: Ugo era l'unica persona su una rete e a ovest di Luca.
clues.en: Ugo was the only person on a net and west of Luca.

clues.it: Elena era nella 7ª riga, accanto a un'ancora e a ovest di Tea.
clues.en: Elena was in the 7th row, beside an anchor and west of Tea.

clues.it: Fabio era in una stanza diversa da Sergio e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Fabio was in a different room from Sergio and on the Deck.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a uno scaffale e in una stanza diversa da Ugo.
clues.en: Sergio was beside a shelf and in a different room from Ugo.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Nino può stare solo nella 4ª colonna: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Nino can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 7th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Luca può stare solo nella 6ª colonna.
steps.en: Luca can only be in the 6th column.

steps.it: Sergio può stare solo nella 9ª colonna.
steps.en: Sergio can only be in the 9th column.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 persona in Cabina» non torna senza Sergio: deve stare in riga 9ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 person in the Cabin” cannot add up without Sergio: they must be at row 9th, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 accanto a un'ancora» non torna senza Fabio: deve stare in riga 8ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 beside an anchor” cannot add up without Fabio: they must be at row 8th, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 accanto a una pianta» non torna senza Nino: deve stare in riga 2ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 beside a plant” cannot add up without Nino: they must be at row 2nd, column 4th.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Tea resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Tea a single square: row 1st, column 7th.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 3ª riga, e lì a Luca resta una sola casella libera: la 6ª colonna.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 3rd row, and it leaves Luca a single free square there: the 6th column.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 accanto a una cassa» non torna senza Paolo: deve stare in riga 4ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 beside a crate” cannot add up without Paolo: they must be at row 4th, column 5th.
